english.title: Use an oversize vehicle in the Queensway Tunnel without express permission
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), in the Queensway Tunnel

(A)_[the height of which (including any load) exceeded 3.90 metres]_
(B)_[without trailers the length of which (including any load or loads and drawbar) exceeded 12.00 metres]_
(C)_[the combined length of the vehicle and trailer, which (including any load or loads), exceeded 12.00 metres]_
(D)_[the gross permitted weight of which (including any load) exceeded 3.5 tonnes]_
(E)_[the width of which (including any load) exceeded 2.70 metres]_
(F)_[which did not come within any of the classifications of vehicles contained the Schedule of Tolls in force at the time]_
(G)_[which was a passenger carrying vehicle of between 3.90 and 4.75 metres in height and was not using one of the middle lanes]_
(H)_[which was a passenger carrying vehicle with a seating capacity exceeding nine and was not operating a local bus service]_
(I)_[which was a passenger carrying vehicle exceeding 4.75 metres in height]_

without the express permission of a Mersey Tunnels police officer or other authorised officer
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 10 and 16 of the Mersey Tunnels Byelaws 2003.
